crates.name: velocity_mcp
crates.role: High-performance production-ready MCP server with 4 transport modes, 16 built-in tools, plugin marketplace, and enterprise-grade security

crates.name: velocity_mcp_macros
crates.role: Proc-macro crate for compile-time type-safe tool registration via #[mcp_tool]

key_constraints: Four transport modes: stdio JSON-RPC, HTTP/SSE/WebSocket, WebSocket, shared memory
NDA binary protocol with auto-detection and Merkle integrity verification
16 built-in tools all native Rust — no external process required
Capability-based sandbox with Linux seccomp and Windows Job Objects
703 passing tests (unit + integration + fuzz + macro + doc)
Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry tracing
Client SDKs in 4 languages (Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go)
Release profile: opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, panic abort, stripped
